## Problem

What governance / audit problem are you trying to solve? What can't you do
today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like the harness to do. If it touches the public API, sketch the
shape (`hz.<thing>(...)`).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why they fall short.

## Scope check

- [ ] This belongs in the OSS core (runtime primitive devs must trust), not a
      hosted/control-plane concern.
- [ ] It does not require importing a model-vendor SDK into the core.
